mapper.select: select l.*, u.real_name as user_name from oa_leave l left join sys_user u on l.user_id = u.id order by l.id desc
select l.*, u.real_name as user_name from oa_leave l left join sys_user u on l.user_id = u.id where l.user_id = #{userId} order by l.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into oa_leave(user_id, leave_type, start_time, end_time, days, reason, status) values(#{userId}, #{leaveType}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{days}, #{reason}, #{status})
mapper.update: update oa_leave set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
